检测到变换问题！

修复方法：
1. 在合并设置中启用「应用变换」复选框

「应用变换」选项会标准化所有缩放、旋转和位置值，

如果已勾选「应用变换」但仍显示此错误，
请将此作为错误报告。

messages.Scene.cats_atlas_size_mode.po2.desc: Round up to the next power of two. Best for game engines
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_size_mode.quad.label: Quadratic
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_size_mode.quad.desc: Square output, sized to the longer side
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_size_mode.auto.label: Automatic
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_size_mode.auto.desc: Use the smallest size that fits the packed cells
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_size_mode.cust.label: Custom
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_size_mode.cust.desc: Scale proportionally to fit the custom size
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_size_mode.strictcust.de: Use the custom width and height exactly
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_max_width.label: Max Width
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_max_height.label: Max Height
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_padding.label: Padding
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_padding.desc:
Pixels of edge-extended border around each texture.
Stops neighbouring textures bleeding together at lower mip levels in-game
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_crop_uv.label: Crop to UVs
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_crop_uv.desc: Shrink each cell to the area its UVs actually use
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_pixel_art.label: Pixel Art
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_pixel_art.desc: Resample with nearest neighbour to keep hard pixel edges
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_color_size.label: Color Size
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_color_size.desc: Cell size in pixels for materials that have a color but no texture
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_max_tiles.label: Max Tiling
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_max_tiles.desc: Largest number of texture repeats to bake in for UVs outside the 0-1 range
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_remap_all_uv_layers.des:
Rewrite every UV map, not only the one the textures use.
Leave off unless your extra UV maps are copies of the first
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_remove_originals.label: Remove Original Materials
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_remove_originals.desc:
Drop the material slots left unused after atlassing, as Material Combiner does.
Turn off to keep them for a manual revert; Undo works either way
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_output.label: Save Atlas
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_output.desc: Where the generated atlas image is kept
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_output.pack.label: Pack into .blend
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_output.pack.desc: Store the atlas inside the blend file
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_output.disk.label: Save to Folder
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_output.disk.desc: Write the atlas out as a PNG file
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_save_path.label: Folder
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_save_path.desc: Folder to write the atlas PNG into
messages.OptimizePanel.atlasNew.label: Atlas Generator
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_map_normal.label: Normal
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_map_normal.desc: Generate a normal map atlas. Written as Non-Color data
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_map_emission.label: Emission
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_map_roughness.label: Roughness
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_map_roughness.desc: Generate a roughness atlas. Written as Non-Color data
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_map_metallic.label: Metallic
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_map_metallic.desc: Generate a metallic atlas. Written as Non-Color data
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_map_ao.label: Ambient Occlusion
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_map_ao.desc:
Generate an ambient occlusion atlas.
Principled BSDF has no AO input, so the source is matched on texture name and the image is left unconnected for you to use in your game engine
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_map_height.label: Height
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_map_height.desc:
Generate a height atlas from displacement or bump inputs.
Left unconnected, since displacement is rarely wanted on an avatar
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_pack_metallic_smoothnes:
Combine metallic and roughness into one MetallicSmoothness image, with metallic in red and smoothness in alpha, as Unity's Standard shader expects.
Replaces the two separate maps
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_secondary_scale.label: Secondary Scale
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_secondary_scale.desc:
Resolution of every map except albedo.
UVs are the same whatever the size, so a smaller normal or roughness atlas costs nothing but disk and memory
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_secondary_scale.full.de: Same size as the albedo atlas
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_secondary_scale.quarter: A quarter of the albedo atlas size
messages.CatsAtlas.item.low_confidence.label: Uncertain Texture
messages.CatsAtlas.item.low_confidence.desc: This material's texture was found by a fallback search rather than traced from its shader, so it may be the wrong one. Baking resolves it exactly
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_bake_size.label: Bake Size
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_bake_size.desc: Resolution each baked material is rendered at, before it is packed into the atlas
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_bake_samples.label: Bake Samples
messages.Scene.cats_atlas_bake_samples.desc: Cycles samples per bake. Only ambient occlusion needs more than a few; the other passes read material values rather than trace light
messages.CatsAtlas.warn.bakeUnsupported: Cycles cannot bake these maps, so they were copied instead: {maps}
messages.CatsAtlas.warn.blendModeMismatch: Layer {layer} mixes blend modes: {modes}. The atlas gets one material with one blend mode.
messages.CatsAtlas.warn.missingUvLayer: {object} has no UV map named {layer}; those faces were mapped through the atlas UV map instead
